risks.quote: You should critically evaluate any output generated by AI, as they can be inaccurate, biased, incomplete or incoherent.
You should critically evaluate any output generated by AI, as they can be inaccurate, biased, incomplete or incoherent.
Note that many AI tools used for transcription do not keep your data secure

However, allowing the use of Gen-AI in all cases could harm learning. If you don’t have a good understanding of your subject area without Gen-AI, you won’t be able to assess the outputs of Gen-AI effectively.

responsibilities.quote: You should critically evaluate any output generated by AI
Always cross-check facts and never submit AI-generated text without review
ensure you are using AI tools in line with the guidance of your Course Coordinator, including acknowledging them appropriately.
Whenever you use AI for an assessment, you should consider these Responsible Use Guidelines, which include the ethics of the tool, data privacy, intellectual property, and reliability.
